results.ao_statement: APPROVAL FOR THE RNS SYSTEM. THIS DEVICE IS INDICATED AS FOLLOWS: " ... AS AN ADJUNCTIVE THERAPY IN REDUCING THE FREQUENCY OF SEIZURES IN INDIVIDUALS 18 YEARS OF AGE OR OLDER WITH PARTIAL ONSET SEIZURES WHO HAVE UNDERGONE DIAGNOSTIC TESTING THAT LOCALIZEDNO MORE THAN 2 EPILEPTOGENIC FOCI, ARE REFRACTORY TO TWO OR MORE ANTIEPILEPTIC MEDICATIONS, AND CURRENTLY HAVE FREQUENT AND DISABLING SEIZURES (MOTOR PARTIAL SEIZURES, COMPLEX PARTIAL SEIZURESAND/ OR SECONDARILY GENERALIZED SEIZURES). THE RNS SYSTEM HAS DEMONSTRATED SAFETY AND EFFECTIVENESS IN PATIENTS WHO AVERAGE 3 OR MORE DISABLING SEIZURES PER MONTH OVER THE THREE MOST RECENT MONTHS (WITH NO MONTH WITH FEWER THAN TWO SEIZURES), AND HAS NOT BEEN EVALUATED IN PATIENTS WITH LESS  FREQUENT SEIZURES."
